Partition IDs by Density-Based Clustering (Reserved, Not Implemented)

Source: R/compute_posterior.R
partition_dbscan.Rd

Placeholder for an automatic, density-based partition strategy. Constructing this object is allowed (so it can be passed around and inspected), but resolve_partition always errors on it – auto-detection is not implemented yet.

Usage

partition_dbscan(eps, minPts, ...)

Arguments

eps

Reserved.

minPts

Reserved.

...

Reserved.

Value

A partition_strategy object that always errors when resolved.
